title: Retention of Released Property Tax Refund Excess After Charge Advances or Inspection Fees
content:
For a returned property tax refund on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the reserve may keep part of the excess that is released, depending on what the Summit loan's ledger (Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage) shows.

## Rule

- Where the Summit loan's ledger shows a corporate advance for property tax or for insurance posted within the twenty-four months before the handling date, the reserve keeps the full retention share, 1 (all), of the released excess.
- Where it shows no such advance but shows an occupancy inspection fee posted within the twelve months before the handling date, the reserve keeps the half retention share, 0.5, of the released excess.
- Where it shows neither, this rule retains nothing.

The borrower keeps the released excess times one less the reserve's retention share. A posting counts when it is dated no later than the handling date and fewer than 24 (or 12) whole calendar months before it.

## Truth table

| Charge advance in 24 months | Inspection fee in 12 months | Reserve keeps | Borrower keeps |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | All | None |
| Yes | No | All | None |
| No | Yes | Half | Half |
| No | No | Not set by this rule | Not set by this rule |

## Hypothetical figures

With a released excess of 300.00: under the full share the borrower keeps 300.00 times one less 1, nothing; under the half share the borrower keeps 300.00 times one less 0.5, 150.00.
